entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the State informs that since the present appellant also belongs to SC category, therefore, the offence under Atrocities Act has since been deleted.

3. Counsel for the appellant while taking this Court to the prosecution version submits that the prosecutrix aged about 37 years submitted a written application on 08.12.2024 to the effect that she had created an ID at Jeevansathi.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:11709 2 CRA-4981-2025 com website and she came in touch with the present appellant.
Thereafter, they remained in touch on mobile phone and the present appellant stated that he is a widower and financially well off.
Thereafter, the appellant took some money from the prosecutrix on the pretext of financial hardship and promise to transfer his Ertiga car in return of such money taken from the prosecutrix.

While the prosecutrix and the appellant came to know each other, then on 27.08.2023, he came to the house of prosecutrix at Vidisha and there, he gave false promise of marriage and made physical relations with the prosecutrix.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the FIR, it is alleged that the amount of Rs. 7.00 lacs taken from the prosecutrix has not been returned by the present appellant and she is suffering from financial problems.

It is also contended by the counsel for the appellant that the matter basically relates to money transactions between the present appellant and the prosecutrix and that he has already returned the money, though after registration of the FIR.
On these grounds, it is prayed to grant benefit of bail.
4. Per contra, learned Panel Lawyer for the State has vehemently opposed the appeal on the ground of material available in the case diary.

5. Heard.
6.
Considering the submissions advanced by the learned counsel for the parties, but without commending on the merits of the case, this Court is inclined to grant bail to the appellant.

It is hereby directed that the appellant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac Only) with two solvent sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:11709 3 CRA-4981-2025 trial Court concerned.
Criminal appeal stands allowed and disposed of.
9. A copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance and information.
10. C.C. as per rules.
